caption: Chronicles promises a ruling son of David; Matthew presents Jesus as Son of David. The wider link is plausible, but Solomon is the immediate temple-building heir.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Chronicles promise Jesus? God says one of David’s sons will rule after him. Matthew repeatedly presents Jesus as the Son of David.
slides.body: God says one of David’s sons will rule after him. Matthew repeatedly presents Jesus as the Son of David.
slides.heading: Did Chronicles promise Jesus?
